bio: Housed in Korb's Remstalhalle, this restaurant with an attractive glass façade has retained a certain 1970s feel, while incorporating chic modern design features. Jochen Gromann serves up flavoursome seasonal cuisine drawing on regional and international influences. In addition to à la carte options – including Swabian Zwiebelrostbraten (fried beef and onions in gravy), there are also set menus. The menu features a wine recommendation for each dish. Chef Nadine Gromann manages the friendly and professional front-of-house team. Delightful terrace – with a view of the vineyards, depending on where you sit....
